steps.title: Sulfoxidation and glycosylation to give 3
steps.instruction: Starting from thioether 1, oxidize to sulfoxide 2 and then perform a Pummerer‑type glycosylation with uracil to afford the 4′‑thiouridine analogue 3 (combined 50 % yield over the two steps).

substeps.instruction: Oxidize thioether 1 to sulfoxide 2 (reagent: meta‑chloroperoxybenzoic acid, solvent: anhydrous CH₂Cl₂, under nitrogen).
Without isolation, treat sulfoxide 2 with uracil under Pummerer‑type conditions to give nucleoside 3.

steps.title: Remove 5′‑O‑TBDPS protecting group
steps.instruction: Treat compound 3 with tetrabutylammonium fluoride (TBAF, 1 M in THF) to cleave the 5′‑O‑tert‑butyldiphenylsilyl group, affording the 2′,3′‑bis‑O‑acetonide protected nucleoside 4 in 82 % isolated yield.

steps.title: Acetonide hydrolysis to free nucleoside
steps.instruction: Hydrolyze the 2′,3′‑bis‑O‑acetonide of 4 by stirring with water and Dowex® 50W X8 H⁺ resin; filter off the resin and isolate the free nucleoside 5 in quantitative yield.

steps.title: One‑pot two‑step full silylation
steps.instruction: Subject nucleoside 5 to a two‑step, one‑pot silylation sequence (reagents: HMDS, TMSCl, TMSOTf, DIPEA, etc.) to furnish the fully silylated nucleoside 6 in 55 % yield.

steps.title: Regioselective desilylation to give 7
steps.instruction: Treat fully silylated 6 with hydrogen fluoride–pyridine complex (HF·pyridine) to selectively remove the 3′,5′‑silyl groups, delivering the 2′‑O‑tert‑butyldimethylsilyl protected nucleoside 7 in 74 % yield.

steps.title: 5′‑O‑tritylation to afford intermediate 8
steps.instruction: React nucleoside 7 with freshly recrystallized 4,4′‑dimethoxytrityl chloride (DMTrCl) in pyridine (or suitable base) to install the 5′‑O‑DMTr group, giving intermediate 8 in 88 % yield (based on 20 % recovery of 7).

substeps.instruction: Recrystallize DMTrCl as described in step 12 before use.

steps.title: Phosphitylation to generate building block 9
steps.instruction: Phosphitylate intermediate 8 at the 3′‑hydroxyl using 2‑cyanoethyl di‑isopropylchlorophosphoramidite and DIPEA in anhydrous CH₂Cl₂ to obtain the 4′‑thiouridine phosphoramidite 9 in 50 % yield.

steps.title: Prepare brine solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 37 g NaCl in 100 ml deionized water (fill beaker to ~2/3 with water, stir until most solid dissolves, let remaining solid settle, then store the saturated solution).

steps.title: Degas reaction vessel
steps.instruction: Attach a nitrogen‑filled balloon to the septum of the reaction flask and a venting needle to a gas bubbler; evacuate the vessel, refill the balloon with nitrogen, and repeat to fully replace the atmosphere with nitrogen.

steps.title: Make 5 % v/v H₂SO₄ in ethanol
steps.instruction: In a beaker with a stir bar, add 190 ml ethanol, cool to 0 °C (ice/ H₂O bath) for 10 min, then slowly add 10 ml concentrated H₂SO₄ with a graduated pipette while stirring; keep at 0 °C for an additional 5 min, seal in a screw‑cap container, and store at room temperature. Neutralize with saturated NaHCO₃ before disposal.

steps.title: Monitor reaction by TLC
steps.instruction: Withdraw 10–100 µl of reaction mixture, quench or dilute with ~500 µl of the reaction solvent, spot alongside starting material and a co‑spot, develop the plate in the prescribed eluent, visualize under UV (λ = 254 nm) then spray with 5 % H₂SO₄ in ethanol and heat.

steps.title: Recrystallize DMTrCl
steps.instruction: Place ~3 g DMTrCl in a 250‑ml round‑bottom flask, add ~80 ml hexane, reflux; add hexane in 5 ml portions until all solid dissolves, then cool to room temperature, place in an ice/ H₂O bath for 1 h to induce precipitation, filter under vacuum, rinse solid with 4 × 10 ml ice‑cold hexane, dry under vacuum for 10 min, then further dry under high vacuum for 2 h, backfill with nitrogen, seal with a septum, wrap in foil and store at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Reflux suspension and add hexane portions until dissolution.
Cool to rt, then ice bath 1 h for crystal formation.
Vacuum‑filter using Büchner funnel, rinse with ice‑cold hexane.
Backfill with N₂, seal, foil‑wrap, store.

steps.title: Prepare saturated NaHCO₃ solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 11 g NaHCO₃ in 100 ml deionized water (fill beaker to ~2/3, stir until most solid dissolves, let any undissolved solid settle, then store the saturated solution).

description: In terms of difficulty, the experimental procedures described in the above protocol range from simple deprotection steps to more complex techniques requiring extra precautions such as anhydrous reaction setups, the use of degassed solvents, and the use of hazardous substances. Where appropriate, further guidelines and necessary precautions have been included within the protocol. In our experience, reactions with 4′‐thionucleosides generally take longer than reactions their 4′‐oxo counterparts, evident when performing the 5′‐O‐tritylation. We found it necessary to use only freshly recrystallized DMTrCl to achieve acceptable yields.
